title: Pre-registered control: tip overlap is necessary for the collapse
caption: Three arrays at 20°. With slits too short to overlap (porosity 0.10) the array keeps 20.0 N/m, 78% of the untilted value; with overlapping tips (porosity 0.20 and 0.30) the ligaments between the tips fail first and link across the sheet. Screened REBO2, athermal quasi-static uniaxial tension along x; colour: energy change per atom relative to the relaxed state (eV); red rings: atoms that have lost a bond; frames between stored quasi-static states are interpolated. All statements are model results.
slow_motion: 3x within ±0.0025 strain of first damage, peak load and major propagation
